ppnote.title: Folium
ppnote.summary: 取代 Acrobat Pro 的 PDF 工作站，手寫是一等功能。iPhone、iPad、Mac 原生。
ppnote.summary_en: A PDF workstation to replace Acrobat Pro, with handwriting as a first-class feature. Native on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

ticket-watch.title: Ticket Watch
ticket-watch.summary: 售票網站的有票區監看 Chrome 擴充功能：只盯票與提醒，購買由使用者自己操作。
ticket-watch.summary_en: A Chrome extension that watches ticketing sites for available seats. It only watches and alerts; buying is left to you.

kaku.title: Kaku
kaku.summary: iOS 拍照 App，以及配套的相機知識庫。
kaku.summary_en: An iOS camera app, plus its companion camera knowledge base.

pastee.title: 貼貼 Pastee
pastee.summary: 原生 Swift 剪貼簿管理工具，Mac、iPhone、iPad 以 iCloud 即時同步，iOS 上另有貼貼鍵盤。
pastee.summary_en: A native Swift clipboard manager for Mac, iPhone and iPad with live iCloud sync, plus a keyboard on iOS.

Murmo.title: Murmo
Murmo.summary: 完全在本機執行的 macOS 語音助手：語音輸入、即時口譯字幕、會議紀錄、筆記問答。
Murmo.summary_en: A fully on-device voice assistant for macOS: dictation, live translated captions, meeting notes and notes Q&A.

layer.title: 層 · Ceng
layer.summary: 個人知識庫的原生版：macOS 桌面版、iPhone 版與分享選單擴充，SwiftUI。
layer.summary_en: The native client for my personal wiki: a macOS app, an iPhone app and a share extension, in SwiftUI.

wiki-chung-men.title: 個人知識庫 Wiki
wiki-chung-men.summary: 自架的個人知識庫：條目、知識圖譜，並提供 API 給原生 App 與 AI 工具使用。
wiki-chung-men.summary_en: A self-hosted personal knowledge base: entries, a knowledge graph, and an API for native apps and AI tools.

cyber-banxian.title: 賽博半仙 CyberBanxian
cyber-banxian.summary: 八字、紫微、占星、人類圖、塔羅加上 AI 諮商的多功能命理 PWA。
cyber-banxian.summary_en: A fortune-telling PWA: BaZi, Zi Wei, astrology, Human Design, tarot and AI counselling.

kaijiang.title: 開講
kaijiang.summary: 一句話生出一份能上台講的簡報：AI 生成、現場互動、逐字稿與語音。
kaijiang.summary_en: One sentence in, a stage-ready slide deck out: AI generation, live audience interaction, transcripts and voice.

want-money.title: 潮汛 Tide & Timing
want-money.summary: 台股／ETF 選股建議與買賣時機訊號系統，自架後端，PWA 加推播。
want-money.summary_en: Stock and ETF picks with buy and sell timing signals for the Taiwan market. Self-hosted backend, PWA with push.

thin-planet.title: 瘦瘦星球
thin-planet.summary: 跟朋友一起減肥競賽的 PWA：打卡積分、隱私排行、AI 看圖算卡路里、推播。
thin-planet.summary_en: A PWA for weight-loss challenges with friends: check-ins and points, private leaderboards, AI calorie estimates from photos.

yunyun.title: LINE 預約與教室租借系統
yunyun.summary: 給工作室用的 LINE 預約系統：會員與老師端 LIFF、後台、排程提醒。
yunyun.summary_en: A LINE-based booking system for a studio: member and teacher apps inside LINE, an admin console, scheduled reminders.

forms-fourh-org-tw.title: 協會內部行政系統
forms-fourh-org-tw.summary: 工作上維護的帳務、表單與差勤系統，含手機版 PWA。
forms-fourh-org-tw.summary_en: Accounting, forms and attendance for work, with a mobile PWA.

fourh-enrollment.title: 營隊選課系統
fourh-enrollment.summary: 高中營隊的搶課與二階段選課系統，Vue 3 加 Firebase。
fourh-enrollment.summary_en: First-come and two-phase course selection for a high-school camp. Vue 3 and Firebase.

razzia.title: 自架問答競賽平台
razzia.summary: 以開源專案 Razzia 為底的客製版，活動現場用的即時問答。
razzia.summary_en: A customized build of the open-source Razzia, for live quizzes at events.

mingwen-expedition.title: 明文遠征
mingwen-expedition.summary: 溝通練習 PWA：每日打卡加遊戲化機制。
mingwen-expedition.summary_en: A communication-practice PWA with daily check-ins and game mechanics.

wish-jar.title: 心願存錢筒
wish-jar.summary: 玻璃擬態風格的存錢目標小工具。

chung223.github.io.title: 開發手帳首頁
chung223.github.io.summary: chung223.github.io 個人首頁：GitHub Actions 定時抓 commit 紀錄，產生熱力圖與更新動態。
chung223.github.io.summary_en: This site: GitHub Actions pulls commit history on a schedule and renders the heatmaps and activity.

AutoVerify-iOS.title: AutoVerify iOS
AutoVerify-iOS.summary: 在本機辨識驗證碼的 iOS Safari 擴充：模型直接跑在瀏覽器裡，圖片不離開裝置。
AutoVerify-iOS.summary_en: An iOS Safari extension that solves CAPTCHAs on-device: the model runs in the browser and images never leave the phone.

as-jx.title: 哩程玩家工具箱
as-jx.summary: 哩程票與現金票攻略：中停哩程計算機、兌換表比較、四段票排程器、空中動態。
as-jx.summary_en: Award-ticket and cash-fare tools: a stopover mileage calculator, award charts, a four-segment planner and live flight info.

tymetrofast.title: 機捷快轉
tymetrofast.summary: 桃園機場捷運快速轉乘計算器：直達車加轉乘怎麼搭最快，含航班看板與高鐵餘票。
tymetrofast.summary_en: Finds the fastest express-plus-transfer route on the Taoyuan Airport MRT, with flight boards and HSR seat availability.

Appprize.title: AppPrize
Appprize.summary: 跨區訂閱比價：貼上 App Store 連結，比較各國訂閱價並換算新台幣，找出最省的那一區。
Appprize.summary_en: Compare App Store subscription prices across regions, converted to TWD, to find the cheapest storefront.

share-money.title: 반반 BanBan 半半分帳
share-money.summary: 你先付，我來算。給常常代墊的人用的分帳小工具，可掃發票、拍照辨識明細。
share-money.summary_en: A bill splitter for people who always pay first. Scan receipts or photograph the bill.

cat-dog.title: 謎陣 Grid Hunt
cat-dog.summary: 100 關邏輯推理謎題加每日挑戰，主角可以換成貓咪、柴犬、珍奶或電鍋。
cat-dog.summary_en: 100 logic puzzles plus a daily challenge. Swap the hero for a cat, a shiba, bubble tea or a rice cooker.

ah.title: 唉。嘆氣計數器
ah.summary: 記下每一聲「唉」，看看自己什麼時候、為了什麼而嘆氣。資料只存在裝置裡。
ah.summary_en: Log every sigh and see when and why you sigh. Data stays on your device.

doze.title: 骰寶練習桌
doze.summary: 用假籌碼練骰寶，開骰之前就看見每一組注碼的長期期望值。
doze.summary_en: Practice Sic Bo with play chips and see each bet's long-run expected value before the dice roll.

Competition.title: 競賽名次計算工具
Competition.summary: 給承辦人用的競賽成績計算：名次法、並列與決勝、獎項分配，可離線使用。
Competition.summary_en: Score contests by rank-sum: ties, tie-breaks and prize allocation. Works offline.

g923.title: g923-mac
g923.summary: 讓 Logitech G923 方向盤在 Apple Silicon Mac 上有力回饋，不用 kext、不用關 SIP。
g923.summary_en: Force feedback for the Logitech G923 wheel on Apple Silicon Macs. No kext, and SIP stays on.

mindkiln.title: 女媧工坊 Nuwa Studio
mindkiln.summary: 從一堆文件裡蒸餾出一個人的思維框架，可以對話、也可以預測他會怎麼想。
mindkiln.summary_en: Distill a person's mental models from documents, then chat with them or predict how they would think.

daily-lab.title: Daily Lab
daily-lab.summary: 每天凌晨 3 點由 AI 自動做出來的驚喜小專案。
daily-lab.summary_en: A surprise mini-project built by AI every day at 3 AM.

crufu-run-2026.summary_en: Interactive route page for the 7th CRUFU RUN in northern Taiwan.

persona-forge.summary_en: A persona generator for OpenClaw: pick traits and get four config files.

z-image-prompt-generator.summary_en: A Ghibli-style prompt generator for Z-Image Turbo.
